liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step** (3 reviews): Reviewer thinks this is the best version heard, with some of Jerry's finest soloing; Two major Garcia solos are astonishing, rivaling 11-5-77, and feel big enough to end the set [14][15][20]
- **Big River** (2 reviews): The Big River emerging from Half-Step sounds as if it might slip into disco time; Garcia's main solo is so revved he nearly leaves the drummers a beat behind [12][15]
- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): The Wheel into Wharf Rat is a rare segue, with Jerry's playing exceptional; The Wheel into Wharf Rat is called among the best versions you'll hear [13][19]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer praises Bertha as a great show opener [16]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer lists Deal among favorite first-set songs [20]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer counts this Peggy-O among their all-time favorites [16]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer lists The Music Never Stopped among favorite first-set songs [20]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Terrapin opening the second set is among the best versions, per reviewer [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **Equipment Repairs**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **More Repairs**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **Repairs**: back after 344 archived shows (2200 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [22]
- **Crowd - Jerry's Guitar is Broke!**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]

## The recordings

- **gd77-05-07.sbd.bertha-ashley.26361.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 196 min; rated 4.97/5 by 30 [1]
- **gd77-05-07.rolfe.weiner.6021.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 193 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [3]
- **gd1977-05-07.sbd.miller.88525.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 189 min; rated 4.72/5 by 40 [4]
- **gd1977-05-07.148736.SBD.Betty.Anon.Noel.t-flac2448**: soundboard; 20 songs; 192 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [6]
- **gd1977-05-07.167736.ShureSM57.Sublette.noel.goldey.t-flac2496**: source not stated; 20 songs; 175 min [8]
- **gd77-05-07.sbd.unknown.262.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 164 min; rated 4.72/5 by 53 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the sound perfect; Reviewer calls the sound quality exquisite, with instruments audible clearly from song to song; Reviewer says the sound holds up well on expensive stereo systems [10][15][19][21]

## Around the show

- Band's equipment worked at soundcheck but gave trouble at showtime [6]
- Crowd was rowdy, and the band's equipment failed after working at soundcheck [8]
- Reviewer says the show is as good as the legendary Cornell show the following night, which led them to it [10]
- Reviewer rates this show well above the next night's Cornell show, citing inspired song choices [11]
- Reviewer ranks this show above Cornell on song selection alone and counts it among top five of 1977 [13]
- Reviewer ranks this among the May 7, 8 and 9 shows; prefers 5/9 overall but returns here for set one [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-05-07.sbd.bertha-ashley.26361.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Remaster of the Rob Eaton/The Wizard soundboard, going through MR, DAT, editing, SHN and DAW, by Jay Ashley [1]
- **gd77-05-07.rolfe.weiner.6021.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM 33P mic > TC-152 deck [3]. Also: Reviewer notes only an audience tape is posted, while they own a crisp soundboard [16]
- **gd1977-05-07.sbd.miller.88525.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) D [4]. Also: Audience patch recorded with a Sony ECM 33P onto cassette, with pitch adjusted to match the master reel soundboard [4]
- **gd1977-05-07.148736.SBD.Betty.Anon.Noel.t-flac2448**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Source & Transfer by Anonymous;Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel; source: Source: Betty Cantor's SBD Reel Master > PCM > Beta PCM clone > cloned to wav file on computer by Sony SLHF300 Betamax and modified Sony PCM601esd via spdif… [6]. Also: Show recorded by Steve Rolfe, with a matrix by dusborne, shared by an anonymous source [6]
- **gd1977-05-07.167736.ShureSM57.Sublette.noel.goldey.t-flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by DSF Transfer by Mark Goldey Edited & Mastered by Joe Noel April 02, 2024; source: Shure SM57 > Sony-TC158 (dolby ??) > Master Cassettes [8]
- **gd77-05-07.sbd.unknown.262.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Paper Moon, il negozio on-line della tua musica: [GRATEFUL DEAD - Boston Garden, MA 5.7.1977 - Limited Edition Rsd 2023 Exclusive | 0603497838356](https://www.papmoon.com/grateful-dead-boston-garden-ma-5-7-1977-limited-edition-rsd-2023-exclusive_44795.html) [23]
